dedupe_keys.name: colombia health facilities from the special registry of health service providers reps sites services and installed capacity

description: This dataset holds Colombia's registered health service providers, taken from the Special Registry of Health Service Providers (Registro Especial de Prestadores de Servicios de Salud, REPS) kept by the Ministry of Health and Social Protection, and shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange by the Health Cluster. It combines several downloads: georeferenced sites of the health service provider institutions (IPS), the services they offer and their installed capacity for 2022, a 2021 shapefile of facilities and a 2021 attribute table with codes. HDX dates the content 2021 to 2022, and the text is given in English and Spanish. The Excel workbooks and zipped shapefile, up to about 4 MB each, are free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Coverage is national. Caveats: the files are copies, and the ministry's REPS portal (prestadores.minsalud.gov.co) holds the current registry, so counts may be out of date; capacity means installed capacity such as beds and rooms, not staffed availability. Simulation uses: national facility locations, service mix and capacity for health access, surge and disaster impact models in Colombia. Related records: the INVÍAS national road network (data-colombia-invias-national-road-network) supports travel time analysis to these facilities.
